decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already incorporates the Transak-created wallet, seed-phrase, mint-destination, commission, and prize details into the new FAQ section.
The existing MODIFY adds SIWE access for the Transak-created wallet but leaves the supported-user and protected-flow lists restricted to the earlier crypto paths.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
We also need a new FAQ section explaining how fiat buyers who are unfamiliar with crypto receive commissions and prizes. This is important for mainstream users because a non-custodial wallet is created behind the scenes, with the seed phrase not required, but they may not understand how to reach their rewards.

"How Does a Non-Crypto Fiat Buyer Collect Commissions and Prizes?"

The flow should reassure customers paying by fiat, such as bank transfer, Apple Pay, etc., that everything is straightforward. When the book is minted for $30 through Transak, the buyer automatically receives a non-custodial wallet behind the scenes, with the seed phrase not required. That wallet stores the buyer's NFT and receives all commissions and prizes.

Earning Commissions ($10 per Referral):
The buyer shares a referral code, for example, "use 8421." Whenever another person mints with that code, $10 is sent automatically to the wallet address.
Collection requires no separate action. The buyer signs into <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example> using a one-time email code or SIWE with the wallet Transak created, and the commissions appear immediately. If necessary, we can explain how to export the funds to a bank account or an exchange such as Coinbase.

Earning and Winning Prizes (Tickets for $900/$6,000 Draws):
Every referral automatically assigns tickets for the active prize draws and ties them to the buyer's NFT/wallet.
Fair on-chain randomness runs the draws at approximately ~750 sales for $900 and ~35,000 for $6,000.
Results are published on the Winners page and sent by email.

Prize collection is automatic as well: a winner receives either $900 or $6,000 directly in the wallet and should check the dashboard or email for the notification.

During the Purchase:
A fiat-to-crypto conversion is completed by Transak, which then mints the NFT directly into a newly created wallet address. Nothing has to be configured manually; the process is seamless and non-custodial. The buyer owns the keys without having to manage a complicated recovery phrase immediately.
An email confirmation then provides the mint number, which also serves as the referral code, along with NFT details and a dashboard link at <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example>.

For ebook access, could we use this setup?

Make Login-gated preview the standard experience. The email certificate would carry a large button reading "Read 'The Long Road Forward' Today," while download after verification would appear as a smaller "Save PDF for Later" link. The dashboard and email-linked reader should use PDF.js.

Does that work?

value_updates.transak_created_wallet_siwe_access: Fiat buyers may use SIWE with the non-custodial wallet created by Transak to access the dashboard and view commissions and prizes.

decisions.reason: The source explicitly specifies a one-time email code for the fiat-buyer access path, while the existing MODIFY leaves the earlier magic-link method as the only general authentication method.

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already changes prize payout to automatic wallet transfer and removes the obsolete one-click claim control and claim surface.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records email winner notifications and the required mint-confirmation contents.
Wallet provisioning and mint destination do not alter the PDF.js reader behavior; the separate reader clauses are already represented by the same-message INTRODUCE.
The source retains the $30 price and $10 referral commission and does not change the current revenue-allocation attributes.
Minting into a newly provisioned buyer wallet does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The Transak wallet-provisioning decision does not change the optional gratuity feature, its presets, or its custom-amount option.
The commission already pays automatically and immediately to the referrer's wallet; provisioning that wallet through Transak for fiat buyers does not change the commission rule itself.
The fiat mint wallet destination does not affect the amount, structure, disclosure, ticket behavior, or prize-pool use of secondary royalties.
Provisioning a private buyer wallet and offering authenticated dashboard access does not change unauthenticated access to public leaderboard and pool-value APIs.
